body:
# 🌿 Vanilla Atmosphere

**A lightweight visual enhancement pack that makes Minecraft beautiful without no shaders.**

Vanilla Atmosphere is a modpack designed to make the world feel more alive, more detailed, and more atmospheric without changing the soul of the game. No shaders needed runs great on low end and mid range hardware alike.

---

## ✨ What's Inside?

### 🖼️ Texture & Resource Pack Improvements
Faithful to the vanilla aesthetic, this pack refines the textures of blocks, items, and the UI to feel crisper and more intentional. No PBR, no high-res packs just a clean, consistent look.

### 🌱 Plants & Nature
Grass sways, leaves feel fuller, and forests breathe. Natural biomes now have a lush, living quality that makes exploration genuinely pleasant.

### 🏗️ Block & Building Visuals
Every block feels more meaningful when you're building. Stones, wood planks, and architectural details gain visual depth that rewards careful construction.

## ⚙️ Technical Info

| | |
|---|---|
| **Minecraft Version** | 1.21.11 |
| **Mod Loader** | Fabric |
| **Performance Impact** | Very low |

---

## 💡 Who Is This For?

- Players who want to keep the vanilla feel but improve the visuals
- Anyone on older or mid-range hardware who can't run shaders
- Survival and building-focused players
- People who want a simple but beautiful Minecraft experience

---

> *"Vanilla Atmosphere doesn't change Minecraft. It just makes it more itself."*
